=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:13-81 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: render_prompt.sh no longer invokes render_prompt.py, so the overlay implementation in Python is unreachable at runtime.
  WHY: the shell renderer now does only hardcoded placeholder substitution and never consults WORKFLOW_OVERLAY_PROMPT_OVERRIDES_JSON or WORKFLOW_OVERLAY_REPO_ROOT.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:73-84 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: the shell renderer only checks three specific placeholders and lets other contract variables pass through unreplaced.
  WHY: templates containing variables like {{PLAN_BUDGET_MINUTES}} or {{ISSUE_NUMBER}} can reach stdout literally with no error.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:520-583 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: WORKFLOW_OVERLAY_REPO_ROOT is accepted without validating that the resolved path exists and is a readable directory.
  WHY: Path.resolve() alone can defer the real misconfiguration until later fragment lookups and produce misleading "not found" errors.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:500-506 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: _coerce_overlay_mode_name validates the normalized name, so a hyphen-only mode like "---" can be accepted after replacement.
  WHY: normalization can turn an invalid mode into a string that matches VARIABLE_NAME_PATTERN, so validation can pass for a mode that will never resolve.
- scripts/render_prompt.py:644-661 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: reviewers disagree on whether WorkflowOverlayError is surfaced cleanly from main(); one report says it is falsely flagged, another says overlay errors can still surface uncleanly.
  WHY: deepseek explicitly marked the uncaught-error claim as a false positive because WorkflowOverlayError subclasses RenderPromptError and is caught, while x-ai reported inconsistent error surfacing.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:434-849 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: deleting the _memory_force_tick_* helper family silently disables the force-tick cooldown path.
  WHY: orchestrate_force_tick.sh still guards and calls these helpers, so duplicate dispatch suppression degrades instead of failing loudly.
- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:mode-change | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: the file was made executable with no content change, which is an unexplained out-of-scope mutation.
  WHY: the PR changes only the mode bit (100644 → 100755) on a file outside the declared issue scope.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
